QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to tell you.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Did you not get a Grow-Grow Medal? Or did you just lose it? Well, you're in luck. We're replacing any missing Grow-Grow Medals people have. Would you like one?

no.0: Oh, you don't want it? Even if you don't want it, can't you just accept it for now and then throw it away later...?

1.0: I hope you enjoy your new medal!
